about: A made-up orbit of the synthetic set (seed 498, case grid-hp2000-e0.5-i20: eccentricity 0.5, perigee 2,000 km, 4.0025 revolutions a day), as an AP seed record at its cutoff. A build held a block of displaced states at each of its perigee passages; the build that fixed it holds none. No satellite's data.
